native_mechanism_note: ACCEPTABLE approximation: recipe = concat + white-frame insert + flash sting; fadewhite reproduces the white snap; flash sting preserved via overlay.
description: Quick white-flash impact between clips. Reads as 'sudden shock' or 'reality snap'. Pairs with sharp flash SFX. Reserved for climax peaks — overuse destroys impact.
ffmpeg_recipe: ffmpeg -y -i {clip_a} -i {clip_b} -f lavfi -t 0.2 -i "color=c=white:s=1080x1920:r=30" -i library/sfx/impacts/flash-sharp.mp3 -filter_complex "[0:v]fade=t=out:st={fadeout_start}:d=0.06:color=white[a_out];[1:v]fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.06:color=white[b_in];[a_out][2:v][b_in]concat=n=3:v=1:a=0[v];[0:a][1:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[base];[3:a]adelay={flash_start_ms}|{flash_start_ms},volume=0.65[flash];[base][flash]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0[a]" -map "[v]" -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -c:a aac -b:a 192k {output}

ffmpeg_params.fadeout_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 0.06. Last 60ms of clip_a fades to white.
ffmpeg_params.flash_start_ms: Set = (duration(clip_a) * 1000) - 20. Flash SFX peak aligns with white frame.

audio_recipe: flash-sharp.mp3 (~0.15s) at volume 0.65 — within hard rule #9 band (flash impacts 0.55-0.65). Peak aligned to white frame. No fade — natural attack/decay.
use_cases: Climax peak — moment of revelation / impact
Plot-twist reveal cut (3 conditions hard rule #12)
H5/H6 transition in horror-choice (the 'snap' before consequence)
avoid_for: More than 1-2x per reel — loses impact through repetition
Photosensitive considerations: never >2 flashes within 1 second (epilepsy safety)
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP: full-screen white div z-index 999, tween opacity 0→1→0 over 0.12s, scheduled at impact beat. flash-sharp.mp3 scheduled at same t with volume 0.65.
safety_notes: Photosensitive epilepsy: keep flash <0.15s total, never repeat <1s apart, never >3x per reel.
